scientific_question: Does the changed interaction law simultaneously repair water pair/three-body energies and signed electrical response, and the acetate rotational force while retaining its radial response? Test model capacity using existing consumed development data, not a new geometry campaign.
model: Frozen KERNELb9b9e9bf; frozen disjoint common_water17676+donor17621 baseline with old h/H off. One12coefficient geometry-shared law, same coefficients across La/Dy, no per-state amplitudes.

development_targets.H: Five independent measured susceptibility projections: W9La/Dy dimer01/fartrimer plus qualified La dry-acetate. Energy half-step estimator; alternate estimators retained as consistency information.
development_targets.h: Existing common-basis pair moment cycles, four W9 near/far signed full-vector three-body moment cycles, La donor full moment using explicitly conjugate baseline channel.
development_targets.V: Existing pair interaction energies, four W9 near/far full three-body energies, La donor radial/rotation half-step slopes. Complete model fragment cycles evaluated before residuals; no raw totalQM-minusMM donor-energy offset.
development_targets.report: All eight W8/W9 trimer cycles, constituent individual errors, Dy-minus-La derived contrasts, all available donor endpoint relative energies and both steps. Dy donorcenter available observations report-only; failed Dy susceptibility/correlatedtorque remain unavailable.
development_targets.independence: All targets and consistency cases are consumed development data, not blind validation. Do not count derived contrasts or duplicate estimators as independent fit observations.
development_targets.methods: Water common-basis electronic/noD4 and donor PBE0-D4 labels remain explicit; canonicalCC and tighterW9far are separate reference sensitivities, not silently substituted.

one_bounded_campaign.start_design: zero +15 Sobol points(seed20261023) mapped to[-.1,.1]^4. For each, halve towardzero until normalized fullG SPDfloor1e-6 at every included operator, maximum20 halvings; record unavailable starts.
one_bounded_campaign.H_solver: SLSQP,maximum100iterations/start, unchanged boxes and one fixed likelihood/loss formulation. No adaptive parameter additions, new starts, outer refit or tolerance relaxation.
one_bounded_campaign.conditional_solves: For each admissible terminalH, one bounded linear least squares h solve, then one bounded linear least squares V solve. These produce an initializer, not the final model-capacity conclusion. Report rank/singular values and bound hits.
one_bounded_campaign.weights: Normalize residuals by1a0^3 forchi,1D forvector-mu,1kcal/mol forenergy,1kcal/mol/A forslope. Equal mean squared contribution per observable family; these are development loss scales, not physical accuracy tolerances.
one_bounded_campaign.selection: Keep best feasible among conditional initializer and terminal joint endpoint per start; retain unsuccessful optimizer status and all results. Across starts choose lowest full five-family score, earlier start on exact tie.
one_bounded_campaign.ablations: Same selected V withh=H=0, plus untouched baseline, evaluated without additional fitting. Expose whether mechanics/electrical errors actually separate.
one_bounded_campaign.stop: One first campaign with fixed conditional initialization and one joint refinement per start. Interpret individual residuals and remaining contradictions; no automatic second coefficient-tuning campaign.

joint_refinement.algorithm: One SLSQP refinement per fixed start of all twelve normalized coefficients against the declared equal five-family loss. No staged objective substituted.
joint_refinement.stability: Fixed baseline D0 G D0 minimum eigenvalue >=1e-6 for all64 included operators, including report-only Dy center
joint_refinement.selection: Keep best feasible among conditional initializer and terminal joint endpoint per start; retain unsuccessful optimizer status and all results. Across starts choose lowest full five-family score, earlier start on exact tie.
joint_refinement.limits: Finite nonconvex search cannot prove global impossibility. No new starts, basis terms, data, tolerances, or subsequent adaptive fit campaign.

support: Reuse all completed nativeforce states. Remaining33FD states, one archived-dual diagnostic and8existing donor endpoint baseline exports are finite implementation/data support. Original faileddense-versusiterative gradient-print gate stays recorded. No claim of physical improvement from force tests alone.
outcome: A per-observable physical verdict on this concrete new law; no protein/aqueous free energy, production promotion or transferable-potential claim.

revision.reason: Conditional susceptibility/moment/mechanics fitting alone cannot assess tradeoffs in the simultaneous loss. Use those solutions as initializers for one joint refinement, within the first unrun campaign.
